# ASP algorithms + telemetry (locked)

Before greenfield packages: **awesome-list** (`docs/awesome-list-asp.md`, `docs/awesome-iot-asp.md`) → Firecrawl developer-index / scrape → Context7 for library APIs. See `asp-prior-art.mdc`.

## Algorithm packages

| Package | Spec |
|---------|------|
| 24 h circle | HH:MM:SS diurnal index (+ UTC `ts`) |
| Year timestore | POSIX **now → +1 year** horizon |
| Uniqueness quantum | **0.0006** s for event keys |
| Fit engine | Non-linear **≥16-param SciPy** on **backend** (not browser) |
| Diversity | Different **ciphers**; Fairfax weather inputs; collected telemetry features |
| Anomaly | Every **1 s**; vib quantum **0.0005** g; SciPy in ADK/Colab (`vib_anomaly.py`) — **not** in-browser SciPy |

Frontend stamps `ts` / band / vib tags and runs local suddenFreq heuristics only. Shared SciPy lives under `services/autoroute-adk/`.

## Telemetry logs

- Prefer **structured JSON lines** (one compact heartbeat / line or equivalent ingest object).
- Wire fields follow `docs/api-contract.md` (`schemaVersion: 1`): deviceId, ts, algo, suddenFreq, band (`17-23k` \| `10-20`), power, nightNY, vol, vibClass, holdManual, etc.
- No speech transcripts, street addresses, or site PII in public or telemetry payloads.

## Bands + night (algo side)

- Default TX **17–23 kHz**; LF **10–20 Hz** only when gated/armed; tag telemetry `band` accordingly.
- Night curve (America/New_York 22:00–07:00): **0.5** UI volume steps 0→100%; not a battery ramp.

## Agent must not

- Port SciPy / ≥16-param fits into `public/` browser JS.
- Invent second anomaly implementations outside `iot_asp_autoroute.vib_anomaly`.
- Log or document street-level location PII.
